name: deepseek-desktop
description: Standalone community desktop distribution for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.rust:clippy: node scripts/with-rust.mjs rustup component add clippy && node scripts/with-rust.mjs cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.tauri:dev: node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs runtime:stage && node scripts/with-rust.mjs tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs runtime:stage && node scripts/with-rust.mjs tauri build
scripts.verify: node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs check:i18n && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs test && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs typecheck && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs runtime:test-locale && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs runtime:test-credentials && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs runtime:stage && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs runtime:verify && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs rust:test && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs rust:clippy
